title: Dimension Dependent Correlation Gap Bounds under Restricted Independence
summary: The pairwise independent correlation gap is the ratio of the maximum expected value of a set function under arbitrary dependence to that under pairwise independence, measuring the loss from this independence restriction. Under mutual independence, this gap is universally bounded by $e/(e-1)$ for monotone submodular functions. With pairwise independence, a tighter $4/3$ upper bound was established for several special cases, including $n=3$, and conjectured to hold universally.
